notes: THEME MISMATCH CONFIRMED: 'Consumer Hardware' does not fit — Roblox is a user-generated-content gaming/social platform monetizing via virtual currency (Robux) and has no hardware business. None of the pre-existing theme strings (including 'Consumer Apparel & Retail') genuinely fit a gaming/UGC platform, so a new theme, 'Consumer Internet & Gaming Platforms', is proposed here; recommend reusing this exact string if other gaming/platform names are added later rather than creating near-duplicates. Regulatory/legal context (requested by user): Roblox's own 10-Q discloses increased regulatory investigations and lawsuits (minors' online safety, alleged facilitation of gambling, unsafe design, inadequate controls) in recent periods. A federal multidistrict litigation (MDL) was consolidated into the Northern District of California (JPML order, Dec 2025) with lead plaintiffs' counsel appointed early Feb 2026 — both outside the ~6-month catalyst window so omitted from the dated catalyst list above, but included here for context. Louisiana's attorney general has also sued Roblox over alleged failure to protect children (adults posing as minors, age-gate bypass, explicit user-generated content); no reliable filing date was found this session, so it is not listed as a dated catalyst. The 'Roblox Everywhere' platform-announcement/price-target-hike catalyst from the original 2026-09-14 snapshot entry was NOT independently re-verified this session (WebSearch budget exhausted) and is therefore omitted rather than carried forward unverified. Cash/debt figures and full annual EPS history could not be established this session.
